title: Supplier Questions to Ask Before Buying Hot Stamping Foil

seo.title: Supplier Questions to Ask Before Buying Hot Stamping Foil

content:
A good foil supplier should help you choose the right material for your real paper box project.

## What to Share

Tell the supplier your paper type, surface treatment, artwork size, machine type and required foil color. These details help avoid wrong material selection.

## What to Ask

Ask whether the foil works on your actual paper surface. Ask whether it is better for fine text or large areas. Ask what sample test should be done before production.

## Roll Details

Confirm roll width, roll length, core size, packing method, lead time and batch consistency before ordering.

## FAQ

### Is a color card enough?

No. A color card shows the effect, but the real paper sample proves performance.

## Sample Support

Send your substrate and artwork. We can recommend foil grades for testing.
